postfoundationscrisis.name: Post-Crisis: Applied Limits
postfoundationscrisis.truth: Knowing the limits of formalization, what do we build?
postfoundationscrisis.qfep_connection: After the foundations crisis, these maps explore what happens when incompleteness, bias, and rhizomatic thinking become design materials rather than problems to solve.
postfoundationscrisis.description: Collected maps from deferred sequences — each a standalone exploration that extends the foundations crisis into contemporary territory. Algorithmic bias as lived incompleteness. Rhizomatic networks as alternatives to hierarchical formalization. Molecular design as post-reductionist practice.
learning_objectives: Algorithmic bias as structural incompleteness in classification systems
Rhizomatic networks as non-hierarchical alternatives to tree structures
Molecular design as embodied formal systems
content: CriticalAlgorithms_Algorithmic_Bias_Visualization: Classification systems encode assumptions — see whose edge cases get lost
SpeculativeComputation_Rhizome_Network: Deleuze's rhizome made navigable — connections without hierarchy
AdvancedLaboratory_Lab_Equipment_Simulation: Formal systems become tangible — molecular design as constructive proof
